name: xilinx-fpga-dev
description: ZCode workflows and MCP tooling for AMD/Xilinx FPGA, Vivado, Vitis HLS/embedded, PetaLinux, Alveo/XRT, RTL verification, and hardware debug.

description_i18n.zh-CN: AMD/Xilinx FPGA 开发插件：Vivado 流程、Vitis HLS、Alveo/XRT 加速、RTL 验证、硬件调试六套工作流技能，附带只读 fpga-workspace MCP 与可选 Vivado 自动化 MCP。Windows 与 Linux/macOS/WSL 双平台适配。
description_i18n.en: ZCode-native development workflows for AMD/Xilinx FPGA projects, backed by a read-only local project-analysis MCP and an optional pinned Vivado automation MCP.
